title: Chat API Contracts
description: Contracts for conversational routes (text or voice) of the multimodal meeting agent.

/api/chat.summary: Process a conversation turn (supports text payload OR voice payload).

session_id.description: Unique chat session ID. Reuses or starts a memory sequence.

speech_synthesis_requested.description: Request TTS audio feedback for response.

audio.description: Audio file input (WAV, MP3, WebM) containing user query.

200.description: Successful execution of the turn (RAG or SQL or Dashboard visual).

user_transcription.description: If voice input was provided, this contains the STT result. Null for text-only requests.

response_text.description: The textual answer generated by the local LLM agent.

sql_query.description: The dynamic SQL query executed, if route was sql_analytics.

dashboard_spec.description: Chart.js schema if a visual graph was requested and compiled. Null otherwise.

audio_b64.description: Base64 encoded audio string of the response text (WAV) generated by Kokoro if requested. Null if failed or not requested.

warning.description: Warning message in case of non-blocking TTS failures (UX resilience fallback).

400.description: Invalid input, empty or malformed files, or bad parameter formats.

error.const: Ollama local inference service timeout (exceeded 40s). Please verify that Ollama is running local models.
